verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Datadog serves an llms.txt at docs.datadoghq.com (HTTP 200) that is a documentation index for the platform, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The documented official MCP server adds a second agent-oriented entry point. Missing for 10: evidence of richer agent-oriented doc formats (e.g., llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using the index.
